text: **Hint 1:** Consider the behavior of the Mean Cubed Error loss function. How does the sign of the error term $(y_i - \hat{y}_i)$ affect the overall loss? Think about how cubing a positive number versus a negative number impacts the result.\n\n**Hint 2:** Reflect on the implications of using a cubic function in the loss calculation. How does the loss function respond to overpredictions (where $\hat{y}_i > y_i$) compared to underpredictions (where $\hat{y}_i < y_i$)? Consider the symmetry or asymmetry in the penalization of errors.
